AuditRecord.description: A person's judgement of whether one cited signal supports a case's diagnosis.
AuditRecord.title: AuditRecord

CaseScores.description: Deterministic scores of one case against its labels. No model judges anything.
CaseScores.title: CaseScores

Contradiction.description: Findings that point different ways, kept visible rather than merged away.
Contradiction.title: Contradiction

ExpectedOutcome.description: What a correct system concludes about one scenario. Evaluator truth only.
ExpectedOutcome.title: ExpectedOutcome

IncidentEvidencePage.description: An incident's cited signals by `occurred_at` ascending, then ID ascending.
IncidentEvidencePage.title: IncidentEvidencePage

IncidentListItem.description: A list row: the summary plus the incident's services, primary first, then by name.
IncidentListItem.title: IncidentListItem

IncidentStatusUpdate.description: An operator's status change, based on the version they last read.
IncidentStatusUpdate.title: IncidentStatusUpdate

IncidentTrigger.description: A rule firing cited by the incident, in event time.
IncidentTrigger.title: IncidentTrigger

InvestigationEvidence.description:
Body of GET /v1/investigations/{id}/evidence.

`items` are the diagnosis's cited signals that exist in the investigation's scope
and were known by its cutoff, in citation order and redacted as `/v1/signals` is.
`unverified_signal_ids` are citations that fail that check; a stored diagnosis
should have none, because the workflow checked them before saving it.
InvestigationEvidence.title: InvestigationEvidence

InvestigationRequest.description: Body of POST /v1/incidents/{id}/investigations; limits only lower the configured ones.
InvestigationRequest.title: InvestigationRequest

InvestigationSummary.description: One investigation of an incident, without its usage or diagnosis body.
InvestigationSummary.title: InvestigationSummary

NormalizedSignal.description: A signal row as written by the normalizer.
NormalizedSignal.title: NormalizedSignal

ObservedOutcome.description: What the system produced for one case, read back from runtime tables.
ObservedOutcome.title: ObservedOutcome

ProgressPage.description: Body of GET /v1/investigations/{id}/progress, oldest event first.
ProgressPage.title: ProgressPage

QualitySummary.description: Per-source counts of signals ingested in the window (by `ingested_at`).
QualitySummary.title: QualitySummary

ServiceGraph.description:
A service's dependency neighborhood as of an instant, nearest edges first.

Edges report no `valid_to`: it would disclose what happened after `as_of`.
ServiceGraph.title: ServiceGraph

SignalPage.description: Signals by `occurred_at` descending, then ID descending.
SignalPage.title: SignalPage

TraceEvidence.description: Signals sharing a trace ID, by `occurred_at` ascending, then ID ascending.
TraceEvidence.title: TraceEvidence

get.description: The process is running and serving requests.
Every required dependency answered within the readiness timeout.

post.description: Queue a run of a scenario split with each variant; a worker executes it.

get.description: A run's configuration, aggregate metrics, and every case's outcome.
One case: expected and observed outcomes, scores, the replay, and each citation.

post.description: Record a person's judgement of one citation; reported apart from automatic scores.

422.description: The signal is not cited by this case

get.description:
Incidents by `detected_at` (newest first) with keyset pagination.

Pass a cursor with the same filters; a cursor from another query is 400.
The incident with its services, evidence references, and rule firings.

404.description: Not found in this workspace and replay scope

patch.description:
Resolve or reopen a live incident, at the version the operator last read.

Another writer's change is 409: read again and decide again. The change and
its `incident.changed` event commit together.

404.description: Not found in this workspace and replay scope

get.description: The incident's cited signals, oldest first, redacted as `/v1/signals` is.

404.description: Not found in this workspace and replay scope

get.description: The incident's newest investigations, operator and automatic alike.

404.description: No such incident in this workspace and replay scope

post.description:
Request an investigation of a live incident.

The same key and body return the same investigation; the same key with
another body or incident is 409.

404.description: No such live incident in this workspace

post.description: Publish a batch of source records; each is accepted only after Kafka acknowledges it.

schema.description: Documents the request body. The route validates `records` item by item.
schema.title: IngestRequest

503.description: At least one record failed; retry those with the same IDs

get.description: An investigation's durable state, in the given scope of the token's workspace.

post.description:
Persist a cancellation of a live investigation.

The response shows `cancelled`, or `cancel_requested_at` on a running
investigation, whose worker ends it. Repeating the request is safe.

409.description: The investigation already ended another way

get.description:
Durable progress as server-sent events; see `api/progress_stream.py`.

Each `id` is a `progress_events` ID. A reconnect with `Last-Event-ID` gets the
events after it; an unknown cursor gets `reset` and the whole history.

503.description: Too many open streams, or the database is unavailable

get.description:
The diagnosis's cited signals, checked again against scope and cutoff.

Empty without a root cause. A citation outside the scope or after the cutoff
is listed as unverified, never returned.
An investigation's durable progress after `after`, oldest first.

parameters.description: The last event ID already read
parameters.name: after

schema.description: The last event ID already read
schema.title: After

get.description:
Dependencies and dependents of the service as of a time, up to `hops` away.

A service known to the catalog but not yet observed has an empty neighborhood.

404.description: No such service in this workspace

get.description:
Signals by `occurred_at` (newest first) in the window, with keyset pagination.

A cursor carries its query's window; pass it with the same filters and
leave `since`/`until` out (or equal). A cursor from another query is 400.
Per-source signal counts by quality status and flag, for signals ingested in the window.
Signals carrying the trace ID, oldest first; `truncated` when more exist.
